name: Ace of Cups
title: Ace of Cups
imagery: A great shell-like cup rises from blue waters, filled with light pouring down from above. A lotus blossoms around it.
meaning: The Ace of Cups is the root of Water: love, receptivity and spiritual fulfillment. Your cup is being filled.
numerology: The Ace is the seed of the element.

name: Two of Cups
title: Two of Cups: Love
imagery: Two cups are filled from a fountain springing from a lotus, with two dolphins intertwined above. Water flows between them.
meaning: Love is the perfect union of two. Harmony and mutual attraction bring joy.

name: Three of Cups
title: Three of Cups: Abundance
imagery: Three pomegranate-like cups overflow with water poured from lotuses above. The scene is rich and fruitful.
meaning: Abundance is emotional plenty. Love and joy overflow. Share your blessings and celebrate.

name: Four of Cups
title: Four of Cups: Luxury
imagery: Four cups stand stacked, overflowing from a lotus, set against calm water. The scene is rich but static.
meaning: Luxury is emotional comfort and pleasure. Enjoy it, but beware of complacency.

name: Five of Cups
title: Five of Cups: Disappointment
imagery: Five empty cups form a broken pattern above withered lotus flowers. The water has dried up.
meaning: Disappointment is emotional loss. Grieve what has passed, then look for new sources of joy.

name: Six of Cups
title: Six of Cups: Pleasure
imagery: Six cups are filled by flowing lotuses arranged in a harmonious pattern, glowing with warm light.
meaning: Pleasure is emotional well-being and joy. Enjoy life's sweetness.

name: Seven of Cups
title: Seven of Cups: Debauch
imagery: Seven cups drip with green slime from wilting lotuses above a stagnant swamp. The scene is decadent and unhealthy.
meaning: Debauch is emotional excess and illusion. Indulgence has gone too far. Clear away what poisons you.
affirmation: I choose what truly nourishes me.

name: Eight of Cups
title: Eight of Cups: Indolence
imagery: Eight broken, shallow cups sit above stagnant water, with drooping lotuses that give no flow.
meaning: Indolence is emotional stagnation. Energy has run dry. Find a way to restore flow and vitality.
affirmation: I restore my energy and flow.

ctx.gift: Your gift is the chance to rest and begin again.

name: Nine of Cups
title: Nine of Cups: Happiness
imagery: Nine cups arranged in a square overflow with water from lotuses, glowing with violet and blue light.
meaning: Happiness is emotional fulfillment. Joy and contentment are yours. Enjoy.

ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be fear of loss.

name: Ten of Cups
title: Ten of Cups: Satiety
imagery: Ten cups arranged like the Tree of Life are filled from a great tilting cup at the top, pouring into the others.
meaning: Satiety is emotional fullness. You have everything, but fullness can turn to excess. Appreciate and prepare for change.
affirmation: I appreciate my fullness and stay open.

name: Page of Cups
title: Princess of Cups
imagery: A graceful princess dances in flowing robes covered with crystals, holding a shell cup with a turtle emerging. A swan and a dolphin accompany her.
meaning: The Princess of Cups is gentle, dreamy and imaginative. She brings grace and new feelings.
numerology: The Princess is the element made manifest.

name: Knight of Cups
title: Prince of Cups
imagery: A winged prince rides a chariot drawn by an eagle over water, holding a lotus and a cup with a snake rising from it.
meaning: The Prince of Cups is intense, secretive and passionate. He feels deeply but hides his emotions.
numerology: The Prince is the element in motion.

ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be emotional manipulation.

name: Queen of Cups
title: Queen of Cups
imagery: A veiled queen sits enthroned on still water, holding a shell cup with a crayfish inside. A stork and lotuses surround her, all reflected in the water.
meaning: The Queen of Cups is the mirror of the soul. She reflects others back to themselves with intuition and empathy.
numerology: The Queen is the receptive power of the element.

ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be lost boundaries.

name: King of Cups
title: Knight of Cups
imagery: A winged knight on a white horse leaps over the waves, holding a cup with a crab emerging. A peacock spreads its tail nearby.
meaning: The Thoth Knight of Cups is the active force of Water. He brings graceful idealism and emotional purpose.
numerology: The Knight is the element at its most active.

ctx.future: A romantic or creative pursuit is coming.
